_doc: Injuries. A character holds {injury_id: days_left}; time heals them day by day. cultivation_mult multiplies qi gathering, combat_mult multiplies max_hp/attack/defense; several injuries stack multiplicatively. Suffering an injury you already have resets it to the longer of the two durations. sources: when an injury may be inflicted. chance is the base probability (reduced by (fortune - 10) * fortune_step), table picks which injury by weight. Pills heal with the Effects key heal_injury: an injury id, or "all". treatment_cost: spirit stones a clinic charges to heal it fully (scaled by days left). medicine: Doctor rules (see medicine.gd); npc_treatment_days/npc_treatment_favor/npc_healed_favor (extra favor when the injury is fully healed)/npc_treatment_alignment apply when treating an injured NPC. The npc_mishap source is rolled monthly for every adult NPC (chance scaled by the fraction of a month simulated).

injuries.name: Qi Deviation
injuries.description: Qi runs wild through your meridians. Cultivating is slow and painful.

injuries.name: Damaged Meridians
injuries.description: Your meridians are torn. Qi leaks out faster than you can gather it.

injuries.name: Broken Bones
injuries.description: Several bones are broken. Fighting is out of the question.

injuries.name: Internal Injury
injuries.description: A blow bruised your organs. You cough blood when you exert yourself.
